data.app_description: Business Automation Insights component.
data.short_description: BAI Management Service - Backend API and data processing engine
data.long_description:
The Management Service is the core backend API and data processing engine for Business Automation Insights. It provides RESTful APIs for the Cockpit UI, coordinates event processing with Flink, manages data queries to OpenSearch, and handles authentication with Zen. The service runs two containers: a frontend API container (port 6898) and a backend processing container (port 8443).

If the Management Service is down, the Cockpit UI will be unable to retrieve analytics data, event processing coordination will fail, and users will not be able to access business insights. This impacts real-time monitoring, historical analytics, and business process visibility across all CP4BA components.

k8s_objects.name: icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management
k8s_objects.short_description: Main Management Service deployment with frontend API and backend processing containers
troubleshooting: The Management Service has a dependency on CPFS components. If the service is down, please check that dependency services are up and running
Check deployment status: oc get deployment icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management
View deployment details: oc describe deployment icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management
Check deployment logs: oc logs deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management
Check backend logs: oc logs deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management-backend
Verify health endpoint: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management -- curl -k https://localhost:6898/api/v1/health
Verify backend health: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management-backend -- curl -k https://localhost:8443/api/v1/health
Check resource usage: oc adm top pod -l component=icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management
Documentation: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cloud-paks/cp-biz-automation/latest?topic=insights-troubleshooting-business-automation

k8s_objects.name: icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management-*
k8s_objects.short_description: Pod running Management Service frontend API and backend processing containers
troubleshooting: The Management Service has a dependency on CPFS components. If the pod is down, please check that dependency services are up and running
Check pod status: oc get pod -l component=icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management
View pod logs (frontend): oc logs -l component=icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management
View pod logs (backend): oc logs -l component=icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management-backend
Describe pod: oc describe pod -l component=icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management
Check pod events: oc get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=<pod-name>
Exec into frontend container: oc exec -it <pod-name> -c management -- /bin/bash
Exec into backend container: oc exec -it <pod-name> -c management-backend -- /bin/bash

Describe PVC: oc describe pvc icp4adeploy-bai-pvc
Check PVC usage: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management -- df -h /mnt/pv

k8s_objects.short_description: One-time setup job that deploys BAI core processing application for Flink
troubleshooting: Check job status: oc get job icp4adeploy-insights-engine-application-setup
View job details: oc describe job icp4adeploy-insights-engine-application-setup
Check job logs: oc logs job/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-application-setup
Verify job completion: oc get job icp4adeploy-insights-engine-application-setup -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Complete")].status}'
Check if job succeeded: oc get job icp4adeploy-insights-engine-application-setup -o jsonpath='{.status.succeeded}'
Verify bai-core-application.jar: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management -- ls -lh /mnt/pv/flink-web-upload/bai-core-application.jar
Check processing libraries: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management -- ls -lh /mnt/pv/processing-lib
List all deployed JARs: oc exec deployment/icp4adeploy-insights-engine-management -c management -- ls -lh /mnt/pv/flink-web-upload
If job failed, check PVC mount and permissions
If job failed, delete and let operator recreate: oc delete job icp4adeploy-insights-engine-application-setup

data.app_description: Business Automation Insights component.
data.short_description: BAI Operator - Manages the Insights Engine capability and its runtime components
data.long_description:
The IBM Insights Engine Operator is responsible for installing, reconciling, and maintaining the Business Automation Insights capability. It watches the custom resources for the Insights Engine, creates and updates the required Kubernetes objects, and ensures the BAI runtime components remain in the desired state.

If the operator is unavailable, existing BAI runtime workloads may continue running, but automated reconciliation, upgrades, scaling coordination, and recovery from configuration drift or failed resources can be impacted.
